items.q: Melvin Bowles was the bass player, and he was a bass player from Speed Webb - he also joined Milt Senior from the Speed Webb beside me.

ctx.x: And then Melvin Bowles was the bass player, and he was a bass player from Speed Webb - he also joined Milt Senior from the Speed Webb beside me. And we had a wonderful guitar player who sang -- Lester, he was a local player there in Toledo. His first name was
Lester, I can't think of his last name.
